turns.customer: If I return the Breeze Wind Shell from order #1314, do I have to pay for the return shipping?
turns.reply: Return shipping is not mentioned in our return policy, and our policies do not specify whether return shipping fees apply. However, the Breeze Wind Shell from order #1314 is eligible for return until September 26, 2026, provided it is unused and in its original packaging. To make a return, you can send the item back using the return label from your account. Once the warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued to your original payment method.
